image_description: A black, soft-sided roll-up tool pouch or case is laid open on a white surface. It contains an assortment of silver metal tools, primarily wrenches (open-ended and box-end), pliers, and screwdrivers with orange handles. The tools are held in individual elastic loops or pockets within the fabric case.

The boundaries between the black elastic holding loops and the metal tools are slightly blurred, suggesting minor fusion or edge bleeding.
